title: Why You Smell the Way You Do (and How to Pick Fragrance Notes That Balance It)
summary: Sweat is odourless. Bacteria, genes, diet and fabric make your scent. Find your smell profile and the fragrance notes that balance it.
author: Jeff Theefs
